label: GO step, confident a2 choice (logit band -9.3..-10.5) after a rewarded trial, mid-episode (trials 10-65)
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only when the agent picks a2 (model_act==2 for 100% of activations). It never fires at D1 or D2, and never when the agent picks a1. Activation mass is concentrated where the policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) sits in a narrow band around -9.5 to -10.5, which is strongly but not maximally confident a2. It is silent for even more extreme logits (< -10.5, 24k GO steps, almost no activations) and for weaker preferences. The previous trial was almost always rewarded (94% of mass), usually a2 then common S2 (prev_common==0 gives zero activations). So in practice this is a confident a2 stay after a common-rewarded a2 trial, and value is high (7.7-8.1). There is a strong dependence on time in the episode: it peaks at trials 30-50, is weak before trial 10 and silent after about trial 70, which points to slow drift in the hidden state across the episode rather than any task variable. The predicate uses only the current-step policy readout, the observed previous reward, and the trial index; no future variables. Dev: P 0.64, R 0.75, F1 0.69, mass recall 0.90. Without the ep_trial window F1 falls to about 0.5. Magnitude: the top activations are at GO with prev reward 1 after common a2 trials; magnitude was not otherwise checked.
